lyrics.ti:
[[chorus]]
እንቋዕ ብደሓን መጻእኩም /2/
ናባይ ናብ ቅድስት ኣዴኹም
ኢደይ ዘርጊሔ ክጽበየኩም /2/
[[/chorus]]

ሽዱሽተ መዓልቲ እናሰራሕና
[[highlight]]ሰንበት ነቕርብ ምስጋናና /2/[[/highlight]]

ንወለድኹም ከተኽብሩ
[[highlight]]ቅዱስ ኣምላኽና ተዛሪቡ /2/[[/highlight]]

ኣሰር ኣቦታት ንኽትስዕቡ
[[highlight]]ኣብ ሰንበተይ ተኣከቡ /2/[[/highlight]]

ከምዚ ኢለ ወትሩ ዝምዕደኩም
[[highlight]]ቤተክርስቲያን’የ ወላዲትኩም /2/[[/highlight]]
lyrics.ti_ro:
[[chorus]]
ʾInqwaʿi bidehan metsaʾikum /2/
Nabay nab qidist ʾadekhum
ʾIdey zergihe kitsbeyekum /2/
[[/chorus]]

Shidushte meʿalti ʾinaserahna
[[highlight]]Senbet neqhrib misganana /2/[[/highlight]]

Niweledkhum ketekhbiru
[[highlight]]Qidus ʾamlakhna tezaribu /2/[[/highlight]]

ʾAser ʾabotat nikhtisʿibu
[[highlight]]ʾAb senbetey teʾakebu /2/[[/highlight]]

Kemzi ʾile wetru zimʿidekum
[[highlight]]Betekristiyan’ye weladitkum /2/[[/highlight]]
